Subject: Renewal planning: contract tooling consolidation (Ironclad + e-sign)

Hi Samir —

Our current Ironclad contract is up for renewal in late Feb and Finance has asked us to evaluate consolidating our CLM + e-sign spend. We currently have a separate DocuSign arrangement for high-volume e-sign; procurement asked whether Ironclad can absorb both CLM and e-sign or whether a blended approach is more cost-effective.

Can you send an updated term sheet with:
- 12- and 36-month pricing options
- Any volume-based discounts for bundling e-sign flows
- Security/data handling language for e-sign artifacts (we need this for Legal)
- Migration/outage plan if we consolidate

I copied Dev (procurement) and Markus (finance) — Evelyn from Legal will review T&Cs and security.

Attachments: none in this initial note.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Renewal planning: contract tooling consolidation (Ironclad + e-sign)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the heads-up. I've attached a draft term sheet with 12/36 month options and a preliminary security annex that covers e-sign artifacts and retention controls. Short summary:
- 36-month bundle (CLM + e-sign) = 18% discount off list + free onboarding credits;
- 12-month bundle = 7% discount;
- We can host e-sign artifacts in a Redshift export or S3 with customer KMS per your compliance needs.

Attachments: Ironclad_Renewal_Term_Sheet_2026.pdf; Ironclad_Security_Annex.docx

Let me know if you'd like a quick call with our product/security team this week.

Cheers,

Thanks Samir — I reviewed the Security Annex and have a few items that must be clarified before Legal can sign off:
1) Data residency: the annex references regional storage but doesn't guarantee EU residency for EU subtenants. Please confirm whether we can restrict artifact storage to a customer-specified region.
2) Retention & export windows: we need a contractually guaranteed export window of 30 days after termination and a confirmation-of-destruction certificate.
3) Subprocessor list: provide current list and 30-day notice for changes.
4) SLA: define e-sign delivery latency objective; we have low-latency requirements for some workflows.

I've redlined the term sheet and attached a small comparison doc where I flagged any risky clauses.

Attachments: RDW-CLM-comparison-sheet.xlsx

Thanks for the term sheet. A few finance/ops items:
- Current annualized spend across CLM + DocuSign is ~$142k. We need to see the blended TCO over 3 years, including any migration costs and any onboarding credits.
- If Ironclad is able to fully take over e-sign at parity we can consider a 36-month commitment, but we need a one-time migration credit to offset rework (~$25k estimate).
- Please provide payment terms: net 30 vs net 45 and any early-pay discounts.

Also cc'ing Tessa (Head of PLG Partnerships) — if we consolidate, we want product access and self-serve flows to remain frictionless for SMB growth teams.
